questions.hint: Find the forward alphabetical skip distance.
questions.explanation: C is 2 positions ahead of A (+2). Similarly, 2 positions ahead of F is H.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Check positional difference: Pos(C) - Pos(A) = +2.
Step 2: Add 2 to the position of F to arrive at H.
questions.memoryTip: Use the EJOTY mnemonic (5, 10, 15, 20, 25) to immediately determine letter indices.

questions.hint: The sum of corresponding letter positions equals 27 (reverse alphabet).
questions.explanation: A and Z are reverse pairs (sum of positions = 27). The reverse letter of F is U.
solutionSteps: Step 1: Pos(A) + Pos(Z) = 27 (opposite letters in alphabet).
Step 2: 27 - Pos(F) gives Pos(U).
questions.memoryTip: Pair mnemonics: AZ (Azad), BY (Boy), CX (Crux), DW (Dew), EV (Even), FU (Full), GT (GT Road).
